task: There is RNA-seq 10X Cell Ranger data and BCR-seq data from 2 patients. You can find metadata related to the patients in the metadata.csv file. For each patient, two measurements was taken: one before influenza vaccination (e.g. 09-0) and the other 7 days after the vaccination (e.g. 09-7). Load the data, perform preprocessing and quality control. Keep only cells with single BCR chain pair. Keep only cells for which both BCR and RNA-seq data exist. Annotate cell types using cell_type.py script. Define clonotypes and perform expansion analysis. Which cell 2 types expanded the most in the young patient 7 days after vaccination? In that same patient before vaccination, what cell types compose the two largest clones? Analyze convergent clonotypes. Which patient displays the bigger convergence change before and after vaccination (output patient id)? For that patient, output convergence change rate.
